name: @battuta/plugin-screencast-keys
description: The keys pressed, with what they did, and the MIDI notes played, shown in the window's corner for video demos and screenshots. Off by default.
//: exports point at src/, NOT a built dist/: Vite and tsc both consume linked TypeScript, so a plugin has no build step and no prepare.
dependencies: @battuta/api and react (the feed renders in the host's float area) and nothing else of the workspace.
